method: Read-only disassembly of original local retail executables compared with pinned OpenJKDF2 packet writers/readers; no retail executable modification.
header: uint16 message type followed by uint16 reliability sequence; lengths below include this four-byte header

differences.name: SABERINFO3
differences.optional_block: 72 bytes after float baseRadius at raw offset24; receiver consumes it when baseRadius is nonzero
differences.required_adapter: Narrow final12 bytes to6 outbound; sign-extend final6 bytes to12 inbound. Keep header and reliable sequence.

differences.name: SYNCTHING / UpdateState
differences.finding: Original retail writes float32 light. The pinned native source wrongly casts the sender light to int32 while its reader already expects float32. Server patch corrects sender to float32.

differences.name: CHAT (MotS only)
differences.original_format: int16 recipientCount, recipientCount*int32 recipient player slots, int32 senderSlot, int32 textLength, text bytes including terminator
differences.canonical_format: int32 recipientSlot, int32 senderSlot, int32 textLength, text bytes including terminator
differences.required_adapter: For broadcast, insert count1 before the existing -1 recipient outbound, strip count1 inbound. Private/multiple recipient lists must be filtered to matching destination player slots, never broadened to all peers.
differences.mode_scope: Original JK and inspected native/browser writers/readers use canonical layout; only original MotS uses the list prefix.

additional_JK_layout_checks.name: THINGPOS
additional_JK_layout_checks.result: Matches native guid32, attach16, sector16, vec3 position, vec3 angles, conditional physicsflags32/vec3 velocity/vec3 angular velocity, player float32 pitch.
additional_JK_layout_checks.smoothing: Original receiver helper0x004f5440 and native sithDSSThing_MoveToPos both use velocity compensation below a0.5-distance threshold instead of always assigning exact received position.

additional_JK_layout_checks.name: FIREPROJECTILE
additional_JK_layout_checks.result: Matches native JK field order and widths: guid32, four16-bit fields, two vec3, two floats, guid32.

additional_JK_layout_checks.name: DEATH
additional_JK_layout_checks.result: Matches: two guid32 and uint8 cause.

additional_JK_layout_checks.name: DAMAGE
additional_JK_layout_checks.result: Matches: two guid32, float32 damage, int16 hitType.

additional_JK_layout_checks.name: SURFACESTATUS
additional_JK_layout_checks.result: Matches native field widths/order including optional adjoin flags.

additional_JK_layout_checks.name: INVENTORY
additional_JK_layout_checks.result: Matches: two int16 indices, float32 amount, two uint32 flags, three float32 timing values.

additional_JK_layout_checks.name: POV puppet state
additional_JK_layout_checks.result: Inspected writer matches native: two uint32 prefix values; four tracks with uint32 status and conditional uint32 key/flags, two int16 priorities, four floats.

additional_JK_layout_checks.name: SETWEAPONMESH
additional_JK_layout_checks.result: Matches: guid32, model32, two int16 twinkle values.

limitations: This is a targeted format audit, not exhaustive validation of every game packet, gameplay path, retail update, or modern engine commit. Runtime movement/interaction receipts are recorded separately.

additional_MotS_layout_checks.name: CREATETHING
additional_MotS_layout_checks.reader: 0x00545b50; absolute sector DWORD read at0x00545ba7 and pointer advances4
additional_MotS_layout_checks.result: Original MotS sector index is int32 in both directions. Canonical server and browser format agree. Pinned unchanged native client erroneously reads int16, handled by server native-edge narrowing for absolute packets.

additional_MotS_layout_checks.name: FIREPROJECTILE and extended MotS fire
additional_MotS_layout_checks.result: Original MotS uses canonical JK fire body; extended type45 appends int32 extra parameter, matching inspected native writer/reader.
